phase_name: Final Judgment Report on Phase 15-7/15-8 Pre-Execution Readiness
phase_japanese_name: Phase 15-7/15-8 実行直前最終判定レポート設計
purpose: Design the final comprehensive judgment report synthesizing results from Phase 18-2 (Phase 15-7 checks), Phase 18-3 (Phase 15-8 checks), Phase 18-4 (evidence locking), Phase 18-5 (HOLD/HALT handling), and Phase 18-6 (ABORT conditions) into a unified PROCEED/HOLD/HALT readiness declaration

scope_1_pre_execution_readiness_synthesi.description: Synthesize all pre-execution check results (Phase 18-2 through 18-6) into unified readiness assessment

step_1_aggregate_phase18_2_results.action: Aggregate Phase 18-2 pre-execution check results (8 checks, 20 check items from 5 groups)
step_1_aggregate_phase18_2_results.aggregation_rule: If all 8 checks PASS → READY_TO_EXECUTE; if any FAIL → HOLD or HALT depending on category

step_2_aggregate_phase18_3_results.action: Aggregate Phase 18-3 pre-execution check results (8 checks base + Group 6 Phase 15-7 integration checks)

step_3_aggregate_phase18_4_evidence_lock.action: Aggregate Phase 18-4 evidence locking results for both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 check results

step_4_aggregate_phase18_5_failure_handl.action: Summarize Phase 18-5 failure remediation status (if any checks failed)

data_aggregated.check_failures_detected: NONE | MINOR_REMEDIAL | BLOCKING_CONDITION | AUTHORITY | RECEIPT | TAMPER | SECURITY

step_5_aggregate_phase18_6_abort_conditi.action: Summarize Phase 18-6 ABORT condition monitoring status
step_5_aggregate_phase18_6_abort_conditi.abort_action_if_needed: If any condition detected before launch: ABORT immediately, route to Phase 18-5 recovery

scope_2_final_judgment_decision_logic.description: Design decision logic to synthesize all 5 aggregated results into unified PROCEED/HOLD/HALT judgment

precedence_1_critical_failure_halt.condition: Evidence tampering detected (step_3 TAMPERING_SUSPECTED) OR Receipt failure (step_4 HALT_RECEIPT) OR Unresolvable blocking (step_4 FAILURES_UNRESOLVABLE_HALT) OR Active abort condition (step_5 detected)
precedence_1_critical_failure_halt.action: DO NOT PROCEED. Escalate to Phase 18-5 HALT procedure or Phase 18-6 ABORT recovery.

precedence_2_fixable_failure_hold.condition: Check failures detected (step_4 MINOR_REMEDIAL or BLOCKING_CONDITION or AUTHORITY) AND remediation in progress or completed
precedence_2_fixable_failure_hold.action: Wait for failure remediation completion. Re-run Phase 18-2/18-3 checks. If results PASS, proceed to PROCEED.

precedence_3_all_clear_proceed.condition: ALL of the following true: (a) Phase 18-2 overall_phase15_7_check_status=READY_TO_EXECUTE (b) Phase 18-3 overall_phase15_8_check_status=READY_TO_EXECUTE (c) Phase 18-4 evidence locks VERIFIED_INTACT (d) Phase 18-5 NO_FAILURES or REMEDIATED (e) Phase 18-6 abort conditions CLEAR
precedence_3_all_clear_proceed.action: All pre-execution gates cleared. Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow ready to launch. Proceed to Phase 18-8 for final authorization certification.

scope_3_final_judgment_report_structure.description: Structure of the final judgment report to be produced at Phase 18-7 execution

content: All 8 base checks + Group 6 Phase 15-7 integration checks
Phase 18-4 lock_ids for Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8
Hash verification results (recomputed hash vs stored)
Chain of custody verification (Phase 18-2/18-3 → Phase 18-4 → Phase 18-7)
List of any check failures (if none, state 'NO_FAILURES')
Classification of failures (minor, blocking, authority, etc.)
Status of remediation (completed, in progress, escalated)
Each category status: CLEAR | DETECTED | MONITORING_ACTIVE
If any detected: description and immediate action taken
Final abort conditions status: ALL_CLEAR | CONDITIONS_PRESENT (if present, HALT judgment)
If PROCEED: Ready for Phase 18-8 final authorization certification
If HOLD: Which remediation step required, expected timeline
If HALT: Reason, escalation required, next steps

phase_18_7_completion_criteria: Pre-execution readiness synthesis procedure (5 aggregation steps) designed
Final judgment decision logic (3 precedence levels) designed
Final judgment report structure (6 sections) designed
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
